summary: Frontend testing of WINEK P0 bug fix: LocationContext + Haversine distance pipe. All 4 critical features verified and PASSING. Distances on HomePage and Search page correctly update when user changes location via Set Global Location screen.

ui_bugs.issue: Location row in search page shows hardcoded text 'Gare Montparnas......75014 Pa...' (line 226) instead of dynamically reading from LocationContext. Distances are computed correctly, but the displayed address string is static.

action_items: search.tsx line 226: replace hardcoded 'Gare Montparnas......75014 Pa...' with dynamic location.address from useLocation() context so the displayed location label reflects the user's actual location
critical_code_review_comments: search.tsx locationRow (line 226): hardcoded address string never updates — should use `location.address` from useLocation() context

set-location.tsx: router.back() throws 'GO_BACK was not handled' console warning when user navigates directly to /set-location URL (e.g., deep-link or manual URL entry). In normal in-app flow (via icon on map/search header) it works correctly. The setLocation() context call still executes, so the location IS saved. Only the back-navigation fails on direct URL access. This is dev-only warning but could block users who reload the page on /set-location. Mitigation: add router.canGoBack() check and fallback to router.replace('/(tabs)/map')

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows pass; 1 minor hardcoded string UI issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 distance bug is FIXED. Full test flow verified: login -> map (shows distances 1.5-9.9km from Paris) -> click location icon -> Set Global Location -> select Home (Montesson 48.9041,2.1499) -> Choisir -> back to map (distances updated to 7.8-18.4km). Search page also updates distances reactively. LocationContext, Haversine pipe, and setLocation() all working correctly. Minor: hardcoded location address string in search.tsx and potential router.back() issue on direct /set-location URL access.
rca_of_issue: Original P0 bug: distances were read from AsyncStorage on mount but never updated reactively. Fix implemented: (1) LocationContext.tsx with useState + setLocation() updating both React state and AsyncStorage atomically; (2) map.tsx and search.tsx now depend on location from useLocation() hook — any call to setLocation() triggers immediate re-render of both screens; (3) haversineDistance() pure function calculates distance client-side from tagpoint lat/lng fields. Verified: Before=Paris(1.5-9.9km), After=Montesson(7.8-18.4km) confirming correct ~15km shift.
